plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
Exit high-beta software (METU, MSFU, PLTU) to zero.
Trim SPY to reduce concentration below 25%.
Hold remaining positions with tight stops.
Focus on capital preservation and low volatility.
Maintain a significant cash buffer.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation. Expect lower potential gains but also reduced volatility and drawdown. The focus is on reducing risk and holding a larger cash position.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and high-beta software/semis (METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU) to reduce overall risk.
Add a new, high-scoring long setup (APP) to diversify and capture upside.
Maintain a balanced mix of broad index, quality tech, and some leveraged exposure.
Keep cash buffer around 10%.
Focus on risk-first growth with controlled concentration.
Total adds are balanced by trims.
balanced.read: This plan aims for risk-first growth. It balances reducing existing concentrated risks with adding new opportunities. Expect moderate gains and controlled drawdowns, with a focus on maintaining a healthy risk-reward profile.

plan: Increase exposure to high-beta software (METU, MSFU, PLTU) and leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU).
Add a new, high-scoring long setup (APP) to concentrate on top opportunities.
Accept higher concentration and leverage to pursue aggressive growth.
Maintain a smaller cash buffer (~5%).
Utilize strict stop discipline to manage potentially larger drawdowns.
Be aware of leveraged ETF decay and rebalancing effects.
aggressive.read: This plan is designed for aggressive growth, accepting significantly higher risk and potential for larger drawdowns. It leans into leverage and concentration on high-conviction names and setups. Leveraged ETF decay is a key risk to monitor.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Increase allocation to QQQI for income generation.
Prioritize steady monthly distributions over capital appreciation.
Maintain a cash buffer for stability.
Focus on low drawdown and reliable income streams.
Accept lower growth potential in exchange for income stability.
income.read: This plan focuses on generating steady monthly income. It significantly reduces volatility and growth potential by exiting high-risk assets and increasing exposure to income-generating assets like QQQI. Distributions are not guaranteed and NAV can still decline.
